preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices, both of which are within the range from 1 to n inclusive.
The number of pairs of interesting vertices k is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n and xi != yi for xi, yi in pairs)
preconditions.description: Each pair of interesting vertices consists of two distinct vertices, both of which are within the range from 1 to n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of results is equal to the number of pairs of interesting vertices k.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result < 1000000007 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer less than 1,000,000,007.

postconditions.expression: results[i] == count_distinct_simple_paths(pairs[i][0], pairs[i][1]) % 1000000007 for i in range(k)
postconditions.description: Each result is the number of distinct simple paths between the corresponding pair of interesting vertices, modulo 1,000,000,007.
